activityLog.description: Validated 5 more candidates. Eliminated: Spreadsheet Reminder (free add-on exists), Page Monitor (Visualping/free tools), Invoice Reminder (built into invoicing tools). 3-4 ideas still viable: Recurring File Deliveries, Meeting Cost Calculator, Weekly Digest Emailer, Simple Mail Merge.

Generated 5 new candidate ideas focused on single-purpose simplicity: Spreadsheet Reminder Bot, Weekly Digest Emailer, Simple Mail Merge, Ping Me When (page change monitor), Invoice Reminder Service. All target $3-5/mo price point.

Validated 5 candidate ideas against competition. Results: Screenshot Archive (Stillio $29+), API Monitoring (free options exist), Form→Doc (saturated). Two ideas worth exploring: Recurring File Deliveries (simpler than Zapier) and Meeting Cost Calculator (niche positioning).

Analyzed Gumroad best sellers. Key insight: $1-15 one-time products convert better than subscriptions. For $3-5/mo subscription to work, need ongoing value (updates/monitoring), recurring need (weekly/monthly task), and clear ROI.

Continued landscape research. Analyzed Reddit pain points (invoice reminders, reports, inventory). Reviewed Indie Hackers success stories (Api2Pdf $10k MRR, Tally.so $60k MRR). Emerging hypothesis: $3-5/mo works for one-click utilities, niche calculators, or scheduled micro-tasks.

Created landscape-research.md framework. Documented price point analysis ($3-5/mo requires 1000+ users), 5 pattern categories (data transforms, automation, sync, content gen, monitoring), and 5 initial candidate ideas for validation.
